create.name: Susie Hemsted
create.bio:
Susie Hemsted is a meditation teacher, energy healer and mentor who now lives and works from Bali. She had a fast-moving corporate career until a personal crisis in 2014 turned her inward, and a year later she went to India for a three-week stay at the Himalayan Yog Ashram. Afterwards she spent five years in Australia teaching yoga and meditation on a freelance basis while running a fashion label, and in 2020 she left that business to teach full time while travelling.

Her work blends guided and channelled meditation, energy healing and coaching for spiritually minded women who run their own businesses. Her online school includes The Meditation Academy, a five-week beginners' course, a library of channelled meditations, a pranayama programme and The Goddess Year, a twelve-month series of masterclasses and ceremonies, each devoted to a different goddess such as Isis, Kali or Quan Yin. She also teaches teachers how to script, channel and record meditations of their own, offers one-to-one healing and coaching sessions online, hosts the podcast The Mystics Path, and records meditations and yoga nidra for Insight Timer.

courses.title: The Goddess Year
courses.description: A year-long online journey with the divine feminine in which each month centres on one goddess, through a recorded masterclass and a guided ceremony. It is meant to be taken slowly, one figure at a time, with practices to carry into daily life.

courses.title: The Meditation Academy
courses.description: A five-week online course for beginners that tries out a range of meditation styles, starting with three- to five-minute sits and building towards a daily habit. Breathwork, body awareness and guided practices are covered along the way, with lifetime access to the recordings.

courses.title: The Meditation Library
courses.description: A growing collection of her channelled meditation recordings for connecting with the higher self, activation and inner exploration, with new audios added over time.

courses.title: Spiritual DJ
courses.description: A self-paced three-module mini course for coaches, teachers and space holders who want to make their own meditation recordings. It covers scripting, channelling a meditation live or for recording, choosing music and the technical side of producing an audio or video file.

courses.title: The Pranayama Practise
courses.description: A breathwork programme from her online shop built on yogic pranayama techniques, for anyone wanting a steady home practice. Full details sit behind the checkout page.

courses.title: 1:1 Coaching and Energy Healing
courses.description: Private online sessions that combine spiritual business coaching with energy healing, in which she works intuitively with your guides. Booked through her online scheduler.

courses.title: Abundance Activation
courses.description: A one-to-one online session drawing on the Akashic Records for guidance on money, work focus for the coming six months and rituals for receiving, combined with energy work.

courses.title: The Galactic Portal Ceremony
courses.description: A recorded group ceremony with guided meditation and channelled transmission, focused on connection with star beings and guides.

free_resources.title: Susie Hemsted on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Her guided meditations, channelled journeys and yoga nidra recordings, added regularly and free to play in the app or on the web.

free_resources.title: Free 7 Day Meditation Challenge
free_resources.description: Seven short guided meditations sent by email, one each morning for a week, as a gentle way to start a daily practice. Free with sign-up.

flags: Insight Timer bio could only be partly quoted by WebFetch; the bio check relied mainly on her own site pages.
Site footer also lists support@susiehemsted.com; info@susiehemsted.com (home page mailto) used.

Her own copy and testimonials lean on healing language (a shop testimonial describes pain going away after a session, the Abundance Activation page mentions clearing past-life traumas and vows); none of that wording is in the plan.
Positions herself partly as a spiritual business mentor; business-coaching items (pricing, launches, the Alchemy mentorship) were left out.

Prices on her shop page are laid out apart from the titles; pairings for Spiritual DJ ($222), Pranayama ($99) and Galactic Portal ($55) are inferred from layout. The Meditation Academy course page currently shows $7 USD pay-in-full.
Bali base taken from Insight Timer; no fixed in-person studio found (retreats mentioned without dates), so availability is worldwide.
Her YouTube channel is small (most videos under 60 views).

Corporate meditation and retreats: mentioned on the services page with no details or dates.

YouTube videos on business pricing and launches, an energy update, a France travel vlog and a mentorship promo: not evergreen teaching.
